ITBWildlife.dll third-party notices
===================================

ITBWildlife.dll is built with the libraries below. Their notices are reproduced here as their licences ask.
The licence of the DLL itself is in ITBWildlife-LICENSE.txt, and its source code is a separate download
(ITBWildlife-0.1.0-source.zip, also in the repository under DLL/): https://github.com/CageTV/ITB

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CommonLibSSE-NG (alandtse fork) - https://github.com/alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Licensed GPL-3.0-or-later with the Modding Exception and the GPL-3.0 Linking Exception (with Corresponding
Source) of that project (EXCEPTIONS.md in its repository). The full text of the GPL is in ITBWildlife-LICENSE.txt.
CommonLibSSE-NG is a fork of CharmedBaryon's CommonLibSSE-NG, itself a fork of CommonLibSSE, and uses its own
dependencies; their notices are in the CommonLibSSE-NG repository.
